name: Intruder
desc: Intruder is a powerful vulnerability management platform that helps businesses identify, assess, and remediate security risks across their digital assets. With its comprehensive scanning capabilities and user-friendly interface, Intruder enables organizations to stay ahead of potential threats and maintain a robust security posture.

actions.name: addTarget
actions.description: Add a new target to your Intruder account

actions.name: startScan
actions.description: Start a new scan. Optionally specify target addresses and/or tag names. If no targets or tags are provided, the scan will run on all targets.

actions.name: searchForAnIssue
actions.description: Search for issues with optional filters

actions.name: searchForAnIssueOccurrence
actions.description: Search for occurrences of an issue by ID with optional snoozed filter

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
